The structure of Mg12Cr2Ti2 (Mg6CrTi) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell across 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Cr, Mg, and Ti centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements; Cr and Ti each have 2 Cr/Ti plus 10 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments vary. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and Cr- and Ti-centered polyhedra sharing edges and faces. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites.
